profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Mastery Logistics Systems
profile.summary: Software engineer with experience building production backend systems, distributed services, and AI-focused applications. I’m drawn to applied AI work, especially LLM quantization, fine-tuning, and finding practical ways to deploy efficient models in real-world systems.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- 15k+ product variant filter and search microservice using Mongo/NodeJS/Fastify/Typescript.
- NodeJS/Express web application development with webhook consumer and GraphQL requests.
- Multi-region CI/CD configuration with AWS and Mongo Atlas.
- Shopify theme development with Shopify CLI and VueJS.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Programmatically migrated 4,000+ web pages and images from 2 separate CMS’s using API and Scripting (Python/JS).
- Lead Developer for two university wide site redesigns and launches.
- Email Template development using Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Lyris, and Pardot.
- Cascade CMS Module development using VueJS and Velocity (Apache/Java).

positions.title: Civil Affairs Specialist
positions.description:
- Research and coordinate the planning and production of civil affairs documents
- Plan government interagency procedures for national or regional emergencies
- Conduct civil reconnaissance, Negotiations, and Key leader engagements
- Support national disaster, defense or emergency assistance
